intended_object: The time-t slice of the rescaled pressure force of a specific Euler solution packet (`exactPacket`), packaged as a `SmoothL2Field`. It is used to fill the `force` field of the library's base Sobolev data structure. Inferred from the docstring, the section comment and the uses at lines 3668–3729.
explanation:
The definition takes the pressure field of the library's own `exactPacket` and evaluates it at the rescaled time `timeMap amplitude t`, which is t/amplitude in [0,1]. It then multiplies the result by amplitude⁻² using `SmoothL2Field.mapField`. The companion lemma `localForceField_apply` shows that its pointwise values equal `localForce (t,x)`, and `localForceField_jetLp_continuous` gives continuity in time of the jets. The term is then used only to fill the `force` field of the base Sobolev data bundle (line 3722).

So this is a proof-internal device: it repackages one specific rescaled force inside the library's own `SmoothL2Field` framework so that later regularity statements can be proved. It has no standard counterpart in the literature or in Mathlib. Its docstring ("Local force field, constructed using `SmoothL2Field.mapField`") also names no standard object it would have to match.
